name: @c4ml/desktop
description: Local desktop workbench for C4ML architecture models
author: C4ML contributors

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/copy-resvg-native.cjs && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --loader:.node=copy --asset-names=[name] --outfile=dist/main.cjs && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.cjs && esbuild src/preview-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preview-preload.cjs
